ios.desc:
TidyLife: Life Upkeep

TidyLife helps you stay on top of the recurring tasks that keep everyday life running smoothly. From home upkeep to personal care, TidyLife focuses on the things that are easy to forget but matter most over time.

Key features:
- Organize tasks into clear sections (home, personal care, maintenance, admin, more)
- Set flexible repeat cycles (days, weeks, months, years)
- Track when tasks were last completed
- Simple, distraction-free interface
- Built for long-term habits, not daily to-do noise
- Secure sign-in and cloud sync

Perfect for tasks like:
- Replacing air filters
- Cleaning appliances
- Renewing documents
- Personal care replacements
- Periodic home checks

TidyLife is not a daily checklist. It’s a system for remembering what usually slips through the cracks.

Stay organized. Stay consistent. Let TidyLife handle the reminders.
